input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Sparkling has an unrestricted convenience right on 90 days' notice with no early-termination fee, and Garman has no convenience right at all. This sits at the fallback (60–90 days). Noted only: there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid maintenance fees on a convenience termination (a refund applies on termination for Garman's default under Section 17(c)).

input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: The licence is perpetual while fees are paid and maintenance runs in renewable one-year terms; there is no automatic-renewal mechanic and therefore no non-renewal notice window to exit, which matches our preferred position (renewal by agreement). Noted only: the Fee Schedule should be checked for any maintenance-fee uplift, which is not capped in the body of the Agreement.
